title: .compass/readiness.yml
description: The readiness record `compass readiness` writes: each readiness signal's result for one checkout at one commit. Per checkout and never committed. cli/compass_pkg/readiness_record.py is its one reader and writer; docs/readiness.md describes the freshness rules.

measured_at.description: When the run measured, in UTC. A record older than seven days, or one after now, is stale.

head.description: The HEAD commit measured; null in a folder with no Git history. Stale when the commit is unknown or HEAD is more than 25 commits past it.

path.description: compass.yml, .compass/config.yml, or null when the project has neither.

settings.description: The settings file the run read and its digest. A layer change is a change of this file, so it makes the record stale.

catalog_digest.description: The digest of the readiness catalog this CLI ships. A preset change makes the record stale.

catalogue_digest.description: The old spelling of catalog_digest, written beside it with the same value and read until 9.0.0.

not_run.description: Why a command signal's command did not run; null when it ran or the signal runs no command.

fix.description: For an absent signal: the one change that makes it present, and the file it touches.

key.description: The project key a command signal runs.

command.description: The command text that key declares.

duration_seconds.description: How long the timed test command ran.
